newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: World Bank, IADB to boost Venezuela pension fund.
newsitem.headline: World Bank, IADB to boost Venezuela pension fund.

text.p: The Inter American Development Bank (IADB) and World Bank will each loan Venezuela $100 million towards re-capitalizing its bankrupt state pension fund, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said Tuesday.
"I have an offer, which has to be finalized in the next few days, of low cost and long term financing of $100 million from each institution," Matos told a news conference.

State body Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) will put up another $100 million and the Andean Development Corporation (CAF) has already agreed to loan $200 million for the pension fund, which is being re-capitalized as part of a major restructuring of Venezuela's social security system.
